premium.basis: premium to the closing trading price of the Shares on August 10, 2020, per SC 14D9 filing

lead_asset_stage: Approved (NDA approved Oct 2019); U.S. commercial launch June 2020; TE Rating determination pending

value_inflection_events.event: FDA acceptance of NDA for PF708 and expanded Alvogen collaboration to EU, MENA, and ROW
Positive CRM197 and PF708 news; broader biotech rally
General market rebound following CARES Act enactment
FDA General Advice Letter requiring additional CUHF study for TE Rating, delaying milestone and reducing maximum value
Merger Agreement with Ligand announced at $12.00 + $2.00 CVR

leaked_early.details: No pre-deal rumors or leaks identified; the deal was a 'clean' announcement on August 10, 2020.

notes: Deal was a bilateral negotiation initiated by Ligand after Pfenex's stock was depressed by an FDA setback for its lead asset's TE rating; the Board rejected multiple offers and briefly terminated discussions before accepting a final offer of $12.00 cash + $2.00 CVR, which was within the DCF valuation range.
